question: How is the battery endurance of the Moto G Fast (2020) in owner reviews?
answer: No summary claims passed the evidence check.
draft_answer:
One reviewer said the battery life is the phone's highest selling point, noting it can last three days without a charge under casual use but roughly 12-15 hours of nonstop heavy use. [001d4a456083_1]
Another reviewer called the battery life poor and said it is among the bottom in endurance ratings, dropping 1% per hour or two even when idle. [f85ee5d1b6b5_0]
A third reviewer described battery life as the phone's winning feature and phenomenal. [6ecdd4ca46dc_0]
One reviewer rated battery life as good but not excellent, saying it lasts only a day to a day and a half rather than the advertised three days. [852a4b8608ec_0]
Another reviewer said the battery lasts three full days on one charge. [7aae2c33414d_0]
A further reviewer said the battery lasts three days with general use, calls, and some web surfing without nightly charging. [d11b8d061a83_0]

chunks.text: I do recommend a different case as well as a different screen protector. It should be noted that most, if not all, screen protectors won't totally cover the screen due to design. Truly the battery life is its highest selling point. The 3 day battery life advertisement is somewhat misleading, it is capable of 3 days without a charge as long as it's casual being used. However, with heavy usage on wifi or cellular broadband use it will last approximately 12-15 hrs of nonstop use- which is outstanding for me. As I write this review I've been downloading a large file, uploading my pictures to the cloud, taking and making calls, using messenger and the phone message app, as well as running a malware and virus scan in the background simultaneously. I might add at the time of this review my phone is at 47% battery life.

Good phone except may be for battery. Good phone, great price. Pros, My phone was made in 2021 and has android 10. Phone Made in india not china. Works well, fast. Cons, it is important to mention to potential buyers that battery life is poor. I found out about it after i ordered. There is a website that lists endurance rating for phone batteries. This one is among the bottom. Even just sitting, battery drops by 1% per hr or two. When you actually use it go figure. Guess its ok but there are much better ones out there ( including Motorola) but not at this great price, so there it is

Battery life is its winning feature. Fantastic basic android phone with phenomenal battery life. After breaking my moto g7 power I looked at current specs and this moto got the best reviews for the price. As far as I can tell it is essentially the same phone as my previous one with only a barely noticeably bigger screen. But that's fantastic because I loved my g7 power and this new g power has twice the storage at 64gb and as mentioned before, it has fantasric battery life!

Poor Fingerprint Reader. Pros A good battery life (but not excellent) A large display Good value for the money Cons Not so excellent battery life A heavier phone Poor fingerprint reader The whole reason for purchasing this phone for me was my previous generation Motorola now drains battery fast. I have had this phone for over 3 months, and while the battery holds the charge well, it's nowhere near the raving reviews I read. The product description purports to hold the charge "up to 3 days" but I would say it's only good for a day to day and a half. Keep in mind this is all relative to what you feel is battery should be at. I'm not the kind of person walking around with 20% of charge and ok being unprepared.

In fact, to improve battery longevity, I only charge it to 80% capacity, and it’s still enough to do that. There’s been criticism of the G Stylus’ 4000 mAh battery compared to the G Power’s 5000, but that hasn’t been a factor for me. Reception at the coast has been better than with Iphone 8 Plus and 11 Pro Max phones belonging to other family members. My phone is always the first to have a usable signal. The fingerprint security is spot on. This is not the first phone I’ve had with that feature, but it’s the first where it could be relied on. It is also absolutely wonderful to have a phone loud enough to play music or conference using speaker phone without an accessory speaker. The three cameras give a lot of options. The Iphone owners in the family are probably right that their phone cameras are better.

Separate 2020 from 2021 model reviews please!. The 2021 model is a downgrade from the 2020 Moto G Power. (Do just a little homework & you'll read why.) Amazon should not be lumping their reviews together, as they have different specs and this is misleading to customers reading the reviews. I am pleased with my 2020 model Moto G Power. I feel it's a good value and quality for the money. Particularly pleased with the storage space. If you play games with any graphics intensity at all, know that the 3-day battery claim will not apply. I found that to be a disappointment, given how much battery life is hyped for the Moto G Power. I really only get a full day, maybe, out of the battery if I game a lot that day. If I hardly game at all, I think I get maybe a day & a half to 2 days, at a stretch.

Doesn't Live Up to Other Reviews. I have had my Moto g power for three full days. Mine might be the exception, but battery life not anything special from previous phones. Twelve hours after a full charge and moderate use with no videos, it is at 42%. I will use battery saver over the next cycle to how it compares. It is a step up in display and storage from my Moto x4, but could have waited.

Yes!. It's a good phone in fact I'm using it to write this review lol 4me the battery lasts for 3 full days on 1 charge the only down side it due to how smooth the surfaces are on it it's finger print and smudge Central so clean freaks be warned

Performance upgrade, battery life downgrade over previous similar models. I write this from the perspective of someone whose been using $200 Lenovo-Motorola phones with 5000 mah batteries since November 2017. My first of this category was a Moto E4 plus: very good battery life, good enough performance for the time. Then as my E4 plus aged and battery life declined I bought a Moto G7 Power: it had better specs in pretty much every way and had a longer battery life due to being new. When I ordered this phone I expected the same kind of upgrade: better performance specs, more battery life. Much to my surprise, the new G Power often lost battery % at the same or faster rate than my 17 month old G7 Power.
Excellent battery life.. Bought it just for the battery life and was not disappointed. Battery last 3 days with general use, calls and some net surfing with no charging every night.
